benefit_text: Premiums are up to 2 % for Kharif crops, 1.5 % for Rabi crops and 5 % for horticultural crops. Government subsidizes the rest and pays premiums in North‑Eastern States, Jammu, Kashmir and Himachal Pradesh. Scheme covers natural disasters, pests, diseases and post‑harvest losses, and settles claims quickly.
who_can_apply: All farmers, tenant farmers and sharecroppers who grow notified crops in notified areas can apply. Applicants must have an insurable interest in the crops and a valid land ownership certificate or tenancy agreement. Applications must be made within two weeks of sowing season start.
documents: Passport‑sized photograph, identity proof such as Aadhaar or PAN, land record documents like RoR or LPC, and a declaration about the crop sown.
how_to_apply: Visit the PMFBY official website, click Farmer Corner and select Guest Farmer to register. After registration, log in, fill the application form, upload required documents and choose to pay later or make payment.
